tend:1.en: Outside the drying pavilion, I watched Xiaoxing sort the day's harvest. She told me that rare spirit herbs *tend* to grow at the edge of shadow rather than full light, which is why most disciples walk right past them. She pressed one small leaf into my hand as proof and smiled.

tend:1.line: 'Rare things *tend* to hide in the places no one thinks to look,' Xiaoxing said.

reduce:1.en: At the foot of the outer mountain, I swept fallen spirit-leaves from the stone path each morning. reduce:1.line: 'Daily work will *reduce* the chaos in your spirit, little one.'

process:1.en: Shen Wujiu led me along the outer ridge trail, naming each herb as we passed. 'Learning a spirit-formula is not one leap,' he said. 'It is a long *process* — root before stem, stem before flower.' Clouds rolled below us like a slow river, and the mountain hummed with quiet power.

course:1.hook: At the cliff edge, one word left my lips and the clouds below briefly parted.
course:1.line: 'The *course* of study seems gentle, but each step hides a test.'

sentences.en: The morning lesson followed its usual *course*: first, silent reading under the pine; then, spoken recall at the stone table outside the archive gate; finally, a walk to the cliff edge to feel how each word changed the air.
I finished all three before the mist fully lifted.
sentences.cn: 我在雾气完全散开之前就完成了全部三项。

relationship:1.en: Xiaoxing showed me the herb map she had drawn on a wide leaf. Every plant was linked to a word by a fine ink line. 'The *relationship* between a root and its name shapes the healing,' she explained, tracing one line slowly. A warm confidence settled in her voice as clouds drifted below us.
relationship:1.cnHint: 小星向我解释草药与其名称之间的____如何影响药效。
relationship:1.hook: One line on her map led to a blank space — a name no one had dared learn yet.
relationship:1.line: 'Understand the *relationship* first; the power follows on its own.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing showed me the herb map she had drawn on a wide leaf.
sentences.cn: 小杏给我看了她在一片宽阔的叶子上画的草本图。

sentences.en: Every plant was linked to a word by a fine ink line.
sentences.cn: 每一株植物都用细细的墨线和一个字相连。

sentences.en: 'The *relationship* between a root and its name shapes the healing,' she explained, tracing one line slowly.
A warm confidence settled in her voice as clouds drifted below us.
sentences.cn: 当我们下方的云漂浮时，一种温暖的自信沉淀在她的声音里。

form:1.en: Outside the archive hall, Master Qingwu drew a single character in the air with her finger. It hung there, faintly glowing, holding its *form* against the mountain wind. 'Copy this shape exactly,' she said. I raised my hand and tried — mine blurred at the edges before it faded.
form:1.cnHint: 师尊在藏经阁外凌空画出一个字，要求弟子仿写其____。
form:1.hook: The moment my character faded, a distant peak shook loose a small veil of snow.
form:1.line: 'Hold the *form* steady in your mind before your hand moves at all.'

sentences.en: Outside the archive hall, Master Qingwu drew a single character in the air with her finger.
sentences.cn: 在档案殿外，青梧师尊用她的手指在空中画了一个单独的字。

sentences.en: It hung there, faintly glowing, holding its *form* against the mountain wind.
'Copy this shape exactly,' she said.
sentences.cn: 她说，复制这个形状，要准确无误。

sentences.en: I raised my hand and tried — mine blurred at the edges before it faded.
sentences.cn: 我抬起手试了——我的在边缘模糊了，然后消褪了。

interest:1.en: I paused by the small board near the sect gate where senior disciples posted questions for newcomers. One question had drawn three reply slips; another had none. Shen Wujiu noticed my gaze. 'Your *interest* is the first tool you own,' he said quietly, and the morning wind moved the slips like soft fingers.
interest:1.cnHint: 师兄看出我对布告栏上某个问题产生了____，轻声提醒我。
interest:1.hook: The question with no reply slips bore a word I had never seen before.
interest:1.line: 'Show real *interest* in a word, and it begins to show itself to you.'

sentences.en: I paused by the small board near the sect gate where senior disciples posted questions for newcomers.
sentences.cn: 我在宗门门口附近的小板子边停下，那里资深弟子会为新人贴问题。

sentences.en: One question had drawn three reply slips; another had none.
sentences.cn: 一个问题贴了三张回复单，另一个没有。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu noticed my gaze.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎注意到了我的目光。

sentences.en: 'Your *interest* is the first tool you own,' he said quietly, and the morning wind moved the slips like soft fingers.

simply:1.en: After the outdoor recitation, I asked Shen Wujiu how he remembered so many herb-words without error. He looked at the clouds below and answered *simply*: 'I say each word to the wind until the wind says it back.' It sounded almost too easy — yet his voice carried a calm weight that made me believe him.
simply:1.cnHint: 我问师兄如何记住那么多草药名，他____地给出了答案。
simply:1.hook: That evening, I whispered a word to the wind — and the wind did not stay silent.
simply:1.line: 'I *simply* return each word to the place where I first found it.'

sentences.en: After the outdoor recitation, I asked Shen Wujiu how he remembered so many herb-words without error.
sentences.cn: 在户外背诵之后，我问沈无咎他是怎么记住那么多草本词而不出错的。

sentences.en: He looked at the clouds below and answered *simply*: 'I say each word to the wind until the wind says it back.'
It sounded almost too easy — yet his voice carried a calm weight that made me believe him.
sentences.cn: 听起来几乎太容易了——但他的声音带着一种平静的分量，让我相信了他。

enable:1.en: The stone path outside the archive hall was lined with glowing herbs, each one a word waiting to be learned. Master Qingwu knelt beside a silver fern and said that mastering its name would *enable* us to walk the upper winds. I traced the characters with one finger, feeling the air lift beneath my feet for just a moment.
enable:1.cnHint: 师尊告诉我，掌握这株灵草的名字能____我们踏上高空之风。
enable:1.hook: Then the fern's light turned cold, and something stirred far below the clouds.
enable:1.line: 'Master the word, and it will *enable* you to rise above any storm.'

sentences.en: The stone path outside the archive hall was lined with glowing herbs, each one a word waiting to be learned.
sentences.cn: 档案殿外的石径两边都排列着发光的草本，每一株都是等待被学习的一个字。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu knelt beside a silver fern and said that mastering its name would *enable* us to walk the upper winds.
I traced the characters with one finger, feeling the air lift beneath my feet for just a moment.
sentences.cn: 我用一根手指描摹这些字，感受空气在我的脚下轻微地抬起了一瞬间。

simple:1.en: Outside the sect's eastern gate, Xiaoxing handed me a small clay jar. Inside was a single dried leaf — a *simple* herb, she said, but its one-word name could close a wound before the blood reached the ground. I held it carefully, surprised that such a plain thing could carry so much power.
simple:1.cnHint: 小星告诉我，这株看起来____的草药，其名字却能在瞬间愈合伤口。
simple:1.hook: A thin crack split the jar's clay, and the leaf began to glow on its own.
simple:1.line: 'Do not judge it yet — the most *simple* vessel can hold the deepest word.'

sentences.en: Outside the sect's eastern gate, Xiaoxing handed me a small clay jar.
sentences.cn: 在宗门的东门外，小杏递给我一个小泥罐。

sentences.en: Inside was a single dried leaf — a *simple* herb, she said, but its one-word name could close a wound before the blood reached the ground.
I held it carefully, surprised that such a plain thing could carry so much power.
sentences.cn: 我小心地拿着它，惊讶于这么普通的东西竟能承载这么多力量。

several:1.en: On the wide stone terrace at the sect's entrance, *several* new disciples stood in a row, each holding a scroll of seed-words. Shen Wujiu walked the line slowly, correcting our grip and our breath. I was third from the end, and when he reached me he paused longer than with the others.
several:1.cnHint: 在宗门入口的石台上，____名新弟子手持词卷，等待师兄逐一检验。
several:1.hook: His pause ended when a cold wind rose from beneath the terrace, rattling every scroll at once.
several:1.line: 'I have watched *several* disciples stand here — none held the scroll quite like you.'

sentences.en: On the wide stone terrace at the sect's entrance, *several* new disciples stood in a row, each holding a scroll of seed-words.
Shen Wujiu walked the line slowly, correcting our grip and our breath.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎缓缓走过队列，纠正我们的手势和呼吸。

sentences.en: I was third from the end, and when he reached me he paused longer than with the others.
sentences.cn: 我排在末尾数第三个，他走到我面前时停留得比别人都久。

struggle:1.en: The path up the outer cliff was narrow and wet with morning cloud. Every step felt like a *struggle* against the mountain itself, as if the stone did not yet know my name. Shen Wujiu called down from above that this resistance was not an obstacle — it was the mountain reading me.
struggle:1.cnHint: 攀登外崖时，我感受到每一步都是一场____，仿佛山石在考验我的资格。
struggle:1.hook: Halfway up, a single word carved into the rock began to bleed pale light.
struggle:1.line: 'Every *struggle* on this path leaves a mark the mountain will remember.'

sentences.en: The path up the outer cliff was narrow and wet with morning cloud.
sentences.cn: 外悬崖的小径狭窄而湿润，笼罩在晨雾中。

sentences.en: Every step felt like a *struggle* against the mountain itself, as if the stone did not yet know my name.
Shen Wujiu called down from above that this resistance was not an obstacle — it was the mountain reading me.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎从上面喊下来，说这种阻力不是障碍——是山在读我。

decision:1.en: At the fork of the outer bridge, two word-paths branched into the morning mist. One led to the healing gardens, the other toward the wind-combat terrace. Master Qingwu stood behind me and said nothing — this *decision* was mine alone to make. I breathed slowly, then chose the path that made my chest feel open rather than tight.
decision:1.cnHint: 在两条修炼之路的交叉口，师尊沉默不言，这个____只属于我自己。
decision:1.hook: The moment my foot touched the chosen path, the other one vanished into white fog.
decision:1.line: 'A *decision* made with a calm mind carries more power than any single word.'

sentences.en: At the fork of the outer bridge, two word-paths branched into the morning mist.
sentences.cn: 外桥的分岔处，两条词途在晨雾中分开。

sentences.en: One led to the healing gardens, the other toward the wind-combat terrace.
sentences.cn: 一条通向疗愈园，另一条指向风战台地。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu stood behind me and said nothing — this *decision* was mine alone to make.
I breathed slowly, then chose the path that made my chest feel open rather than tight.
sentences.cn: 我缓缓呼吸，然后选择了让胸口感到开阔而不是紧窄的小径。

kid:1.en: Near the lower gate market, a small *kid* — a young mountain goat — had wandered onto the word-stones, those flat rocks etched with basic formulas for new disciples. It stood very still on the stone marked 'rise,' and for a moment the air around its hooves shimmered faintly silver.
kid:1.cnHint: 在下山门的词石旁，一只小____站在刻有'升'字的石板上，蹄下泛起了银光。
kid:1.hook: The goat looked up at me with eyes that reflected no sky, only cloud.
kid:1.line: Xiaoxing laughed softly: 'Even a *kid* can feel the power in a carved word.'

sentences.en: Near the lower gate market, a small *kid* — a young mountain goat — had wandered onto the word-stones, those flat rocks etched with basic formulas for new disciples.
It stood very still on the stone marked 'rise,' and for a moment the air around its hooves shimmered faintly silver.
sentences.cn: 它在刻着"升"字的石头上站得很静，一瞬间它蹄子周围的空气微微闪现出银光。

ability:1.en: Master Qingwu tested each of us on the open courtyard steps as morning light filled the valley below. When my turn came, she asked me to speak the wind-word clearly once. My voice did not shake. She wrote a single mark in her book and said my *ability* to hold tone and breath together was rare for someone so new.
ability:1.cnHint: 师尊在庭院台阶上逐一考验我们，她说我在音调与气息上的____在新弟子中十分难得。
ability:1.hook: The mark she wrote began to lift faintly off the page, as if the book itself agreed.
ability:1.line: 'Your *ability* is real — now the question is whether you trust it.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu tested each of us on the open courtyard steps as morning light filled the valley below.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在开放的院阶上逐一考察我们，晨光洒满下方的山谷。

sentences.en: When my turn came, she asked me to speak the wind-word clearly once.
sentences.cn: 轮到我时，她让我清晰地说一遍风词。

sentences.en: My voice did not shake.
sentences.cn: 我的声音没有颤抖。

sentences.en: She wrote a single mark in her book and said my *ability* to hold tone and breath together was rare for someone so new.

task:1.en: Shen Wujiu gave us our first outdoor assignment at sunrise, at the edge of the terrace where the clouds began. Our *task* was to speak a chosen word toward the sea of clouds below and listen for the echo that would tell us if the word had taken root. I spoke mine, and waited, and the silence stretched longer than it should have.
task:1.cnHint: 沈无咎在云海边交给我们第一个____：对云海说出所选之词，聆听回响以判断词语是否扎根。
task:1.hook: When the echo finally returned, it spoke back a different word entirely.
task:1.line: 'This *task* sounds small,' Shen Wujiu said, 'but the clouds forget no word spoken to them.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu gave us our first outdoor assignment at sunrise, at the edge of the terrace where the clouds began.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在日出时给我们布置了第一项户外任务，地点在云海开始的台地边缘。

sentences.en: Our *task* was to speak a chosen word toward the sea of clouds below and listen for the echo that would tell us if the word had taken root.
I spoke mine, and waited, and the silence stretched longer than it should have.
sentences.cn: 我说出我的词，等待着，寂静延伸得超过了应有的长度。

put:1.en: On the stone path outside the library hall, I *put* a small jade slip onto the reading stone, the way Master Qingwu had shown me. The slip began to glow with a soft blue light. Shen Wujiu watched from beside the old pine tree, arms folded, saying nothing at all.
put:1.cnHint: 我在藏经阁外的石路上，将一枚玉简____在读石之上。
put:1.hook: The blue glow slowly turned the colour of blood.
put:1.line: '*Put* it down gently, or the words inside will scatter,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: On the stone path outside the library hall, I *put* a small jade slip onto the reading stone, the way Master Qingwu had shown me.
The slip began to glow with a soft blue light.
sentences.cn: 玉片开始绽放出柔和的蓝光。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu watched from beside the old pine tree, arms folded, saying nothing at all.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎从老松树旁看着我，双臂交叉，一言不发。

difference:1.en: Xiaoxing and I stood before two herb jars outside the drying shed. They looked the same to me, but she pointed to the faint rings on each lid. 'That *difference* in colour tells you which herbs are safe,' she said. I had walked past these jars every morning and never noticed a thing.
difference:1.cnHint: 晓星指着两个药罐盖子上的痕迹，告诉我它们之间的____。
difference:1.hook: The third jar, the one neither of us had touched, began to hum.
difference:1.line: 'A small *difference* in colour can save your life,' Xiaoxing said quietly.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing and I stood before two herb jars outside the drying shed.
sentences.cn: 小杏和我站在烘干棚外的两个药罐前。

sentences.en: They looked the same to me, but she pointed to the faint rings on each lid.
sentences.cn: 它们看起来对我来说一模一样，但她指向每个罐盖上的淡淡纹理。

sentences.en: 'That *difference* in colour tells you which herbs are safe,' she said.
I had walked past these jars every morning and never noticed a thing.
sentences.cn: 我每天早上都从这些罐子前走过，却从未注意到任何区别。

lack:1.en: Master Qingwu stood at the mountain gate, watching the new disciples recite their first formulas beneath the open sky. She said nothing for a long while. Then she told me that skill was not what I was missing. My *lack* was not in words, but in stillness. A wind moved through the pines above us.
lack:1.cnHint: 师尊说我并非缺乏天赋，而是____一份内心的静定。
lack:1.hook: The pines grew still, though the wind had not stopped blowing.
lack:1.line: 'Your *lack* is not talent — it is patience,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu stood at the mountain gate, watching the new disciples recite their first formulas beneath the open sky.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊站在山门前，看着新弟子们在开阔的天空下诵读他们的第一批公式。

sentences.en: She said nothing for a long while.
sentences.cn: 她沉默了很久。

sentences.en: Then she told me that skill was not what I was missing.
sentences.cn: 然后她告诉我，我缺少的不是技巧。

sentences.en: My *lack* was not in words, but in stillness.
A wind moved through the pines above us.
sentences.cn: 风吹过我们上方的松林。

case:1.en: Shen Wujiu carried a narrow wooden *case* down the outer steps of the sect hall and set it on the low stone wall by the road. He opened it slowly. Inside lay seven scrolls, each sealed with red thread. He said these were records of disciples who had entered the deep cloud layer and never returned.
case:1.cnHint: 师兄将一个木制____放在路边石墙上，里面装着七卷封存的残卷。
case:1.hook: The red thread on one scroll had already been cut.
case:1.line: 'This *case* has not been opened in forty years,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu carried a narrow wooden *case* down the outer steps of the sect hall and set it on the low stone wall by the road.
He opened it slowly.
sentences.cn: 他缓缓打开它。

sentences.en: Inside lay seven scrolls, each sealed with red thread.
sentences.cn: 里面躺着七卷书简，每卷都用红线封着。

sentences.en: He said these were records of disciples who had entered the deep cloud layer and never returned.
sentences.cn: 他说这些是进入深云层后再也没有回来的弟子的记录。

sure:1.en: I stood at the edge of the outer cliff path, the sea of clouds rolling far below. Xiaoxing asked if I was *sure* the formula I had memorised was complete. I said yes. But as I looked down at my notes, carved into a thin bark strip, one symbol near the end seemed different from what I remembered.
sure:1.cnHint: 晓星问我是否____已经记全了那道法诀，我低头查看树皮上的刻文。
sure:1.hook: The missing symbol was the one that meant 'return.'
sure:1.line: 'Are you *sure* you read the whole scroll?' Xiaoxing asked softly.

sentences.en: I stood at the edge of the outer cliff path, the sea of clouds rolling far below.
sentences.cn: 我站在外悬崖小径的边缘，云海在远下方翻滚。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing asked if I was *sure* the formula I had memorised was complete.
I said yes.
sentences.cn: 我说是的。

sentences.en: But as I looked down at my notes, carved into a thin bark strip, one symbol near the end seemed different from what I remembered.
sentences.cn: 但当我低头看刻在薄树皮条上的笔记时，靠近末尾的一个符号似乎与我记得的不同。

enough:1.en: Outside the sect gate, a travelling herb merchant spread his goods on a cloth by the road. Master Qingwu studied each bundle without touching them. She told us that beauty and rarity were never *enough*; a herb with no true inner force was only a dead leaf with a pleasant smell. The merchant looked away.
enough:1.cnHint: 师尊告诉我们，药草的珍贵外表远远不____，内力才是根本。
enough:1.hook: One bundle at the edge of the cloth was trembling on its own.
enough:1.line: 'Looking rare is never *enough* — feel its inner breath,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Outside the sect gate, a travelling herb merchant spread his goods on a cloth by the road.
sentences.cn: 宗门外的路边，一个游商在布上铺开了他的草药。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu studied each bundle without touching them.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊仔细看着每一捆，但没有伸手去碰。

sentences.en: She told us that beauty and rarity were never *enough*; a herb with no true inner force was only a dead leaf with a pleasant smell.
The merchant looked away.
sentences.cn: 商人转开了目光。

attention:1.en: Shen Wujiu was testing me on herb names in the open yard when a low bell rang from somewhere deep in the mountain. He did not stop his questions. But I noticed his *attention* shift, just for a moment, toward the inner peak. His eyes returned to me quickly, though his face had grown a little pale.
attention:1.cnHint: 师兄考我草药名称时，远处的钟声使他的____短暂地转向了山的深处。
attention:1.hook: The bell rang once more, and this time no one pretended not to hear.
attention:1.line: 'Keep your *attention* on the text, not the bell,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu was testing me on herb names in the open yard when a low bell rang from somewhere deep in the mountain.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在开阔的院子里考我草药的名字，忽然山深处传来一声低沉的钟声。

sentences.en: He did not stop his questions.
sentences.cn: 他没有停止提问。

sentences.en: But I noticed his *attention* shift, just for a moment, toward the inner peak.
His eyes returned to me quickly, though his face had grown a little pale.
sentences.cn: 他的目光很快回到我身上，但脸色已经苍白了一些。

certain:1.en: On the winding path below the library, I found a page caught against a root. The characters on it were unlike anything I had studied. Xiaoxing came up behind me and looked over my shoulder. She said she was *certain* this page belonged to the lost scroll that Master Qingwu had been seeking for thirty years.
certain:1.cnHint: 晓星看着我拾到的残页，____地说这正是师尊寻访三十年的那份残卷。
certain:1.hook: A shadow crossed the page, though the sky above was clear.
certain:1.line: 'I am *certain* I have seen this script before,' Xiaoxing whispered.

sentences.en: On the winding path below the library, I found a page caught against a root.
sentences.cn: 在图书馆下面的蜿蜒小路上，我发现了一张纸片卡在树根上。

sentences.en: The characters on it were unlike anything I had studied.
sentences.cn: 上面的字体与我学过的任何东西都不一样。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing came up behind me and looked over my shoulder.
sentences.cn: 小杏从身后走上来，从我肩膀上方往下看。

popular:1.en: The outer courtyard was busy with new disciples trading scrolls. One formula had become so *popular* that three students copied it by noon. I watched from the stone steps as Shen Wujiu shook his head slowly. 'Copying without understanding is just noise,' he said. The wind through the bamboo agreed, bending every stalk in the same direction.
popular:1.cnHint: 外院里有一个咒诀变得____，弟子们争相抄录，师兄却摇头叹息。
popular:1.hook: Then one copied scroll burst into cold blue flame.
popular:1.line: 'A *popular* formula is not always a true one.'

sentences.en: The outer courtyard was busy with new disciples trading scrolls.
sentences.cn: 外院很热闹，新来的弟子在交换卷轴。

sentences.en: One formula had become so *popular* that three students copied it by noon.
I watched from the stone steps as Shen Wujiu shook his head slowly.
sentences.cn: 我从石阶上看着沈无咎缓缓摇了摇头。

sentences.en: 'Copying without understanding is just noise,' he said.
sentences.cn: "抄写而不理解，就只是噪音，"他说。

sentences.en: The wind through the bamboo agreed, bending every stalk in the same direction.
sentences.cn: 竹林吹过的风应和着他，把每一根竹子都压向同一个方向。

current:1.en: Master Qingwu led us to the Edge Cliff at dawn. Below, the sea of clouds moved like a slow river. 'Feel the *current* beneath the mist,' she said quietly. I stretched my hand over the rail and felt it — a steady pull, warm and alive, like breath from the mountain itself. Xiaoxing gasped beside me.
current:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊带我们感受云海中那股____，那是山脉本身的气息。
current:1.hook: The current suddenly reversed, and the mist rose fast.
current:1.line: 'The *current* below us is older than this sect.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led us to the Edge Cliff at dawn.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在天亮时带我们去了悬崖边。

sentences.en: Below, the sea of clouds moved like a slow river.
sentences.cn: 下方，云海像缓缓流动的河。

sentences.en: 'Feel the *current* beneath the mist,' she said quietly.
I stretched my hand over the rail and felt it — a steady pull, warm and alive, like breath from the mountain itself.
sentences.cn: 我把手伸过栏杆，感觉到了——一股稳定的拉力，温暖而有生命力，就像山本身呼出的气息。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing gasped beside me.
sentences.cn: 小杏在我身边倒吸了一口气。

difficult:1.en: The inner library held ten thousand scrolls, but only one shelf was sealed with red cord. Shen Wujiu said the words on that shelf were *difficult* not because of their length, but because each one carried real weight — speak them wrong and the mountain would answer. I touched the cord once. It was warm.
difficult:1.cnHint: 藏经阁中那排红绳封存的卷轴____，读错一字山脉便会回应。
difficult:1.hook: Somewhere deep in the shelf, a scroll began to hum.
difficult:1.line: 'These words are *difficult* — the mountain does not forgive a careless tongue.'

sentences.en: The inner library held ten thousand scrolls, but only one shelf was sealed with red cord.
sentences.cn: 内库里有一万卷卷轴，但只有一架书架用红绳封着。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu said the words on that shelf were *difficult* not because of their length, but because each one carried real weight — speak them wrong and the mountain would answer.
I touched the cord once.
sentences.cn: 我曾经碰过一次那根绳子。

sentences.en: It was warm.
sentences.cn: 它是温热的。

amount:1.en: Xiaoxing laid out her herb-words on the courtyard stone: seven small ones, each good for a minor healing. 'The *amount* matters,' she told me carefully. 'Too few words and the wound stays open. Too many and the body forgets its own strength.' She arranged them like a careful sentence. Above us, a cloud shaped like a hand passed over the sun.
amount:1.cnHint: 小星将草字排列整齐，告诉我用词的____决定治愈的效果。
amount:1.hook: One herb-word dissolved before she could finish the pattern.
amount:1.line: 'The *amount* of words you use is as important as the words themselves.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing laid out her herb-words on the courtyard stone: seven small ones, each good for a minor healing.
sentences.cn: 小杏在院子的石板上铺开了她的草药字：七个小的，每一个都能治疗小伤。

'Too few words and the wound stays open.

sentences.cn: 她把它们排列得像一个仔细的句子。

sentences.en: Above us, a cloud shaped like a hand passed over the sun.
sentences.cn: 我们头上，一朵形似手掌的云飘过太阳。

point:1.en: Master Qingwu drew a single character in the air with one finger. It held its shape, glowing faintly gold. 'Every formula has a *point*,' she said, 'one word that carries the whole meaning. Find that word and the rest will follow.' I studied the floating character for a long time. When I finally saw its centre, the mountain beneath my feet gave a single, quiet shudder.
point:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊说每个法诀都有一个____，找到它，其余的词语自会跟随。
point:1.hook: The golden character folded inward and vanished without a sound.
point:1.line: 'The *point* of any formula is one word — miss it and the rest means nothing.'

Find that word and the rest will follow.'
sentences.cn: "找到那个字，其余的就会跟上来。"

sentences.en: I studied the floating character for a long time.
sentences.cn: 我长时间地研究着这个浮动的字。

sentences.en: When I finally saw its centre, the mountain beneath my feet gave a single, quiet shudder.
sentences.cn: 当我终于看到它的中心时，我脚下的山给了一声轻微的、沉默的颤抖。

role:1.en: During the morning review, Master Qingwu asked each of us why we came to the Cloud Sea Sect. Shen Wujiu said he came to protect. Xiaoxing said she came to heal. When my turn came, I had no answer ready. 'Every disciple must find their *role*,' Master Qingwu said gently. That evening, a second shadow fell across my own — though no one stood behind me.
role:1.cnHint: 师尊问每位弟子在门派中扮演的____，而我还没有答案。
role:1.hook: The second shadow pointed toward the sealed library shelf.
role:1.line: 'Your *role* in this sect is not given — it is earned, word by word.'

sentences.en: During the morning review, Master Qingwu asked each of us why we came to the Cloud Sea Sect.
sentences.cn: 晨间复习时，青梧师尊问我们每个人为什么来到云海宗。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu said he came to protect.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎说他来是为了保护。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing said she came to heal.
sentences.cn: 小杏说她来是为了治愈。

sentences.en: When my turn came, I had no answer ready.
sentences.cn: 轮到我时，我没有准备好答案。

That evening, a second shadow fell across my own — though no one stood behind me.
sentences.cn: 那个傍晚，第二道影子落在了我自己身上——虽然我身后没有人站着。

survey:1.en: Master Qingwu led us to the eastern cliff at dawn. She asked me to *survey* the garden of living words below — each glowing herb a sentence waiting to be spoken. I counted twelve rows before the mist swallowed the rest. Something down there was moving against the wind.
survey:1.cnHint: 师尊让我在悬崖边____下方的灵草园，我数到第十二行时，迷雾将其余的遮住了。
survey:1.hook: One herb pulsed red — a color no garden should hold.
survey:1.line: '*Survey* every row before you name a single herb,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led us to the eastern cliff at dawn.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在天亮时带我们去了东边的悬崖。

sentences.en: She asked me to *survey* the garden of living words below — each glowing herb a sentence waiting to be spoken.
I counted twelve rows before the mist swallowed the rest.
sentences.cn: 我数了十二行，然后雾就吞没了其他的一切。

sentences.en: Something down there was moving against the wind.
sentences.cn: 下面有什么东西在逆风而动。

care:1.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a scroll wrapped in pale silk. 'Copy these words with *care*,' he said. Each character was a living formula; one crooked stroke could unravel the meaning entirely. I steadied my brush. Outside, the wind carried a low, hollow sound across the cloud sea.
care:1.cnHint: 师兄叮嘱我以____抄写卷轴上的灵文，一笔偏差都可能毁掉整个咒式。
care:1.hook: The hollow sound came again — closer this time, and shaped like a word.
care:1.line: 'Copy every line with *care*, or the formula will turn on you,' Shen Wujiu warned.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a scroll wrapped in pale silk.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎递给我一卷用浅色丝绸包着的卷轴。

sentences.en: 'Copy these words with *care*,' he said.
Each character was a living formula; one crooked stroke could unravel the meaning entirely.
sentences.cn: 每个字都是一个活着的公式；一笔歪斜的笔画就能完全破坏意思。

sentences.en: I steadied my brush.

sentences.en: Outside, the wind carried a low, hollow sound across the cloud sea.
sentences.cn: 外面，风吹过云海时发出了一阵低沉、空洞的声音。

state:1.en: After three days without sleep, I stood before Master Qingwu to recite the Wind Formula. She studied my face and shook her head. 'In this *state* you cannot hold a single syllable steady,' she said. I tried anyway. The word rose from my lips — then shattered like thin ice.
state:1.cnHint: 我连续三天未眠后去背诵风咒，师尊说我此刻的____根本无法稳住任何音节。
state:1.hook: The shattered syllable drifted upward and did not disappear.
state:1.line: 'In this *state*, the words will not obey you,' Master Qingwu said quietly.

sentences.en: After three days without sleep, I stood before Master Qingwu to recite the Wind Formula.
sentences.cn: 三天没睡后，我站在青梧师尊面前背诵《风之诀》。

sentences.en: She studied my face and shook her head.
sentences.cn: 她看了看我的脸，摇了摇头。

sentences.en: 'In this *state* you cannot hold a single syllable steady,' she said.
I tried anyway.
sentences.cn: 我还是试了。

sentences.en: The word rose from my lips — then shattered like thin ice.
sentences.cn: 那个字从我唇边升起——然后像薄冰一样碎裂了。

impact:1.en: Xiaoxing dropped the stone tablet by accident. The *impact* cracked the lower edge, and the carved word for 'still water' began to bleed a thin silver light. We pressed our hands over it together, whispering the repair syllable until the light faded. The crack remained. So did the silence that followed.
impact:1.cnHint: 小星不慎摔碎石碑，____使碑上的"止水"二字开始渗出银光，我们合力才将其压住。
impact:1.hook: In the silver light, a second word appeared that had not been carved there before.
impact:1.line: 'The *impact* released something the carver meant to seal,' Xiaoxing whispered.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing dropped the stone tablet by accident.
sentences.cn: 小杏不小心掉落了石碑。

sentences.en: The *impact* cracked the lower edge, and the carved word for 'still water' began to bleed a thin silver light.
We pressed our hands over it together, whispering the repair syllable until the light faded.

sentences.en: The crack remained.
sentences.cn: 裂纹还在。

sentences.en: So did the silence that followed.
sentences.cn: 之后的沉默也还在。

reason:1.en: I asked Shen Wujiu why certain words could only be spoken at dusk. He was quiet for a long moment. 'There is a *reason*,' he said at last, 'but Master Qingwu has not told even me.' He pointed to the western peak, where the sun was already touching the stone. A thin gold line appeared along the cliff face.
reason:1.cnHint: 我问师兄为何某些灵文只能在黄昏诵读，他说其中有____，但连他也不知晓。
reason:1.hook: The gold line on the cliff spelled a word none of us had been taught.
reason:1.line: 'There is a *reason* for the rule — trust it before you understand it,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: I asked Shen Wujiu why certain words could only be spoken at dusk.
sentences.cn: 我问沈无咎，为什么某些词只能在黄昏时说出来。

sentences.cn: 他沉默了很久。

sentences.en: 'There is a *reason*,' he said at last, 'but Master Qingwu has not told even me.'
He pointed to the western peak, where the sun was already touching the stone.
sentences.cn: 他指向西峰，太阳已经贴近了石壁。

sentences.en: A thin gold line appeared along the cliff face.
sentences.cn: 一道细细的金线出现在悬崖边缘。

close:1.en: The archive pavilion stood at the mountain's edge. Xiaoxing and I sat *close* to the outer railing, sharing a candle and reading the same old scroll. The words on the page shifted as the flame moved, showing different meanings in different light. Below us, the cloud sea breathed slowly in and out.
close:1.cnHint: 我和小星____地坐在藏阁栏边，烛光摇动时，卷轴上的字呈现出截然不同的含义。
close:1.hook: One meaning, glimpsed for only a moment, looked like a warning.
close:1.line: 'Stay *close* — some pages only reveal themselves to two readers at once,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.cn: 我们下方，云海缓缓吸气呼气。

individual:1.en: Master Qingwu laid nine word-seeds on the stone table and told us each one carried an *individual* spirit. No two could be learned the same way. I reached for the smallest seed. It was warm, and it hummed a note that matched nothing I had ever heard — yet felt entirely familiar.
individual:1.cnHint: 师尊说九粒字种各有____灵性，没有两粒能用同样的方式习得，我拿起最小的一粒。
individual:1.hook: The hum grew louder the moment I thought of leaving it behind.
individual:1.line: 'Each *individual* seed will choose the disciple it opens for,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu laid nine word-seeds on the stone table and told us each one carried an *individual* spirit.
No two could be learned the same way.
sentences.cn: 没有两个字能用同一种方式学习。

sentences.en: I reached for the smallest seed.
sentences.cn: 我伸手去拿最小的种子。

sentences.cn: 它很烫，发出一个声音——从未听过，却又莫名熟悉。

area:1.en: Shen Wujiu marked a circle on the courtyard stones with white powder. 'This *area* is where the echo words land,' he told me. 'Step inside and speak, and the mountain will answer.' I stepped in and said a single syllable. The answer came back changed — deeper, older, and not quite my voice.
area:1.cnHint: 师兄在庭院地面划出一片____，说在其中说话，山会给出回应，我试了一个音节。
area:1.hook: The mountain's answer carried a second syllable I had never spoken.
area:1.line: 'Stay within the *area* — outside it, the echo goes somewhere we cannot follow,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.cn: 沈无咎用白粉在院子的石头上画了一个圆。

'Step inside and speak, and the mountain will answer.'

sentences.cn: 答案传了回来，已经变了——更深沉，更古老，不再是我的声音。

develop:2.en: The ancient scroll was sealed with frost. Xiaoxing held a warm stone over it, and slowly the hidden text began to *develop* across the page — word by word, like seeds pushing through cold soil. Each character glowed faint green before settling into ink. We both leaned close, breath held.

develop:2.hook: The last word to appear was not a formula — it was a warning.
develop:2.line: 'Watch how the characters *develop* — each one carries a breath of its own.'

enjoy:2.en: Between lessons, Shen Wujiu and I sat at the cliff's edge above the cloud sea. We did not speak. We simply chose to *enjoy* the quiet — the way the clouds turned gold, the way one herb-word repeated in my mind like a calm bell. It was the first peace I had felt since arriving.

enjoy:2.hook: Then the bell in the inner hall rang — three short strikes, the signal for danger.
enjoy:2.line: '*Enjoy* this stillness. The next scroll will not be so kind.'

sentences.en: We simply chose to *enjoy* the quiet — the way the clouds turned gold, the way one herb-word repeated in my mind like a calm bell.

fact:2.line: 'The *fact* is that we are running out of words — and time.'

several:2.en: In the lower archive, I found *several* torn pages stuffed inside an old ink jar. Each page held half a word — spiritual characters split down the middle, as if someone had divided them on purpose. Shen Wujiu went quiet when he saw them and slowly closed the jar.
several:2.cnHint: 在藏经阁下层，我在旧墨罐里发现了____张残页，每张都写着被刻意劈开的灵字。
several:2.hook: The ink inside the jar was still wet.
several:2.line: 'I have seen *several* of these jars — none of them were left by accident.'

Each page held half a word — spiritual characters split down the middle, as if someone had divided them on purpose.
sentences.cn: 每一页都有半个字——灵性文字被对半分开，仿佛有人是故意这么做的。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu went quiet when he saw them and slowly closed the jar.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎看到它们时没有出声，慢慢地合上了罐子。

struggle:2.en: The ancient text described a disciple whose *struggle* to master one single word lasted nine winters. She could not shape the sound right; her breath kept breaking the character apart. At last she carved it into her own walking staff. That staff, the text said, still stood at the peak — unburned.
struggle:2.cnHint: 古籍中记载了一位弟子为掌握一个字而历经九年____的故事，她的手杖至今仍立于山顶。
struggle:2.hook: The page that named her had been soaked until the name washed away.
struggle:2.line: 'Every *struggle* with a word leaves a mark the word remembers.'

sentences.en: The ancient text described a disciple whose *struggle* to master one single word lasted nine winters.
She could not shape the sound right; her breath kept breaking the character apart.
sentences.cn: 她总是发不出那个音；她的呼吸总是把字符吹散。

sentences.en: At last she carved it into her own walking staff.
sentences.cn: 最后她把它刻在了自己的行走木杖上。

sentences.en: That staff, the text said, still stood at the peak — unburned.
sentences.cn: 那根木杖，文本说，至今还矗立在山峰——未被烧毁。

decision:2.en: The scroll offered two paths forward, written in red and black ink side by side. One word led to healing; the other led to flight. A note at the bottom, in Master Qingwu's own hand, read: every *decision* made here echoes in the clouds below. I stared at both words until my lamp burned out.
decision:2.cnHint: 残卷上并排写着两条路，而师尊亲笔注明：在此做出的每一个____都会在云海中回响。
decision:2.hook: When the lamp died, only the red word remained faintly visible.
decision:2.line: 'A *decision* made in haste feeds the wrong word inside you.'

kid:2.en: A small note fell from between the pages — written in uneven, unsteady strokes, clearly by a child. Xiaoxing read it aloud: a young *kid* had once sneaked into the library at night to copy a single healing word, hoping to save a sick bird. The bird's name was written at the bottom of the note.
kid:2.cnHint: 一张从书页间落出的纸条，出自一个小____之手，他深夜潜入藏经阁只为抄下一个治愈之字。
kid:2.hook: The bird's name was the same as a missing senior disciple.
kid:2.line: 'Even a *kid* who copies one word in the dark plants a seed in the mountain.'

ability:2.en: The scroll I unrolled had only one line, written in deep violet ink: true *ability* with words is not speed, not force — it is knowing which word to leave unspoken. Below it, someone had pressed a dried cloud-petal as a mark. I touched it, and it crumbled to pale ash in my palm.
ability:2.cnHint: 我展开的残卷只有一行字：真正的____不在于速度或力量，而在于知道哪个字该保持沉默。
ability:2.hook: The ash spelled out a character I had never been taught.
ability:2.line: '*Ability* without stillness is just noise wearing the shape of a word.'

task:2.en: Pinned to the innermost shelf was a list in faded ink. Each line described a *task* assigned to a disciple: find the echo word, seal the hollow syllable, return the borrowed tone. Most lines had been crossed out. The last one had no name beside it — and it was not crossed out.

task:2.hook: The last task was written in ink that still smelled of rain.
task:2.line: 'A *task* left unsigned is a task the mountain is still waiting for someone to claim.'

sentences.en: Pinned to the innermost shelf was a list in faded ink.
sentences.cn: 最里层的架子上钉着一张褪了色的清单。

popular:2.en: In the archive hall, I found a shelf of scrolls worn smooth by many hands. Shen Wujiu said the most *popular* formula among disciples was the Wind-Step verse — copied so often the ink had faded to grey. I reached for it, and the scroll trembled, as if it remembered every reader before me.
popular:2.cnHint: 在藏经阁，我发现了一卷在弟子中最____的咒文，它因被反复抄录而墨迹已淡。
popular:2.hook: Then the scroll fell open to a page no one had copied.
popular:2.line: 'The *popular* ones are worn out — read the ones no one else dared touch.'

sentences.cn: 在藏卷堂里，我找到了一架被许多手指磨得光滑的古卷。

sentences.cn: 我伸手去取，卷轴颤动了一下，仿佛记得我之前的每一个读者。

current:2.en: Master Qingwu led me to a narrow bridge above the sea of clouds. Below, a slow *current* of white mist moved like a river with no shore. She placed a single leaf on the air and it followed that invisible path exactly. 'The clouds have their own grammar,' she said. Far off, the leaf vanished without falling.

current:2.hook: The mist shifted, and the bridge was no longer where it had been.
current:2.line: 'Follow the *current* — it knows the mountain's true shape.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led me to a narrow bridge above the sea of clouds.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊领我走上了一座悬在云海上的窄桥。

sentences.en: Below, a slow *current* of white mist moved like a river with no shore.
She placed a single leaf on the air and it followed that invisible path exactly.
sentences.cn: 她在空气中放下一片叶子，叶子精确地跟随那条看不见的路径。

sentences.cn: "云有它自己的语法，"她说。

sentences.en: Far off, the leaf vanished without falling.
sentences.cn: 远处，叶子消失了，没有坠落。

difficult:2.en: The scroll assigned to me was written in an old hand, full of turns and crossings. Xiaoxing leaned over my shoulder and smiled. difficult:2.hook: Outside, wind pressed against the archive door as if something wanted in.
difficult:2.line: 'It is *difficult*, yes — but only the first word costs you everything.'

amount:2.en: Shen Wujiu poured a small measure of luminous powder onto the scale. 'The *amount* matters as much as the word itself,' he said. 'Too little and the formula sleeps. amount:2.hook: One grain rolled off the scale and dissolved in the air before it landed.
amount:2.line: 'The right *amount* is the line between healing and harm.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu poured a small measure of luminous powder onto the scale.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在天平上倒了一小撮闪闪发光的粉末。

point:2.en: Master Qingwu pressed one finger to the centre of the old map. 'This is the *point* all cloud-paths cross,' she said. 'Miss it and you circle the mountain for years.' point:2.hook: When I lifted my hand, the circle had grown slightly larger.
point:2.line: 'Every path has one *point* where the choice becomes real.'

role:2.line: 'Everyone in that ritual had a *role* — someone chose to leave one empty.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing handed me a folded note she had found inside a cracked wall-brick.
sentences.cn: 小杏递给我一张她从裂开的砖缝里找到的折叠纸条。

sentences.en: It listed three names — none of them mine — and beside each, a single word for their *role* in a ritual no one had performed in a hundred years.

sentences.en: But the space below the third name was blank and waiting.
sentences.cn: 但第三个名字下面的空白在等待。

survey:2.en: Master Qingwu led me to the Edge Pavilion, where the mountain dropped away into white mist. She asked me to *survey* the shelf of scroll cases below and note which seals had gone dark. I counted seven cold seals among hundreds of glowing ones. Seven words, lost.
survey:2.cnHint: 师尊命我在悬崖阁____那排卷轴架，记下封印已灭的卷轴。
survey:2.hook: The seventh dark seal pulsed once, then split clean down the middle.
survey:2.line: '*Survey* every shelf before you touch a single scroll,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led me to the Edge Pavilion, where the mountain dropped away into white mist.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊带我来到断崖亭，山在这里坠入白雾。

care:2.hook: When I lifted my brush for the last stroke, the candle flame bent toward the words.
care:2.line: 'Copy it with *care*, or the meaning will be the first thing lost,' Xiaoxing said.
